APPROVE

The two extractions keep the same short-circuit order and side effects, and they remove about five points of nesting-weighted complexity (17 down to roughly 12), so the method should land under 15. I only had the diff, not the surrounding file, so the compile check rests on the new parameter types (`List<SourceTextRef>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) matching the caller's variables, and I couldn't confirm that.
